judge_checks.run: node pipgraft.mjs; node powergraft.mjs; node perkgraft.mjs. They reuse ../v06pd_kitsim lib.mjs + kits.mjs; outputs are in *.out.txt. No project files touched.
judge_checks.perkgraft: Artificer, 8 s chase, mean EHP taken vs the three pursuers: Overdrive 61%, Warp 33%, Ram 38%, Dodge 58%, none 78%. Overdrive retunes (cap x1.3, thrust x1.8, +25% shield, 4 s) only reach 55-57%. The 1-D model always favours displacement, so fairness must come from access rules plus the bot soak, not from this metric.
judge_checks.code_facts:
- Live sim/deployables.ts stepWell pulls hostile ships at the full wellPull (900). This confirms the Gravity Well trap flag.
- Profile.stats {matches, wins, byType{matches, wins}} exists in protocol.ts, so Hero's derived perk unlocks need no schema change.
- Sortie's renames of the mobility*/utility*/afterburner identifiers touch 44 files (~411 hits) in src today. Hero and Arcade keep those names.
- v0.5 is committed (6cd8134). Its capital skill uses mobilityReadyTick + SPACE_CD_TICKS across 4 files, which every kit moves to the E slot.

notes.a: Gamepad table exact; Q passive 100-115 s; per-path Q is allowed; bombs on R; capital skill on E. But the Artificer's RMB becomes the Repair Ray and Deploy Sentry moves to E, which goes against the owner's RMB list (Rocket Salvo / Arc Lightning / Deploy Sentry).
notes.b: One button per slot, but 9 bespoke ultimates, 7 perks, and a pre-path meter cap that queues the path fork.
notes.c: Strongest path identity: the level-3 pick decides Q. But Event Horizon sits on the glass-cannon Arcanist; parked alone on floor 3 it eats about 148% of its EHP in kamikaze contact (kitsim).
notes.e: Best contest rules: capture owner, then strongest pull, 1.3R hysteresis, 1.5 s victor priority. Cheapest wire: a bound bit. But the visible curl is weak (22-41 deg) and there is no Arena trim (2.14x).
notes.f: 24 flags (1 HIGH, 19 MED): the most degenerate surface. The real Arena ult gap is 85-90 s against the 65-74 s claimed. Dungeon ult share is 24/43/36% on floors 1/3/6.
notes.g: Keeps the wire names and PROFILE_VERSION. But it adds 9 bespoke ult systems, a path-gating change in xp.ts, flags2 as u16, 7 perks and 9 bot ult heuristics.

notes.a:
Every slot matches addendum F:
- RMB is exactly Rocket Salvo / Arc Lightning / Deploy Sentry, with an Architect path variant.
- E is exactly the owner's examples: Polarize, Gravity Well, Repair/Docking Ray, plus the Leech Siphon.
- Q is a meter charging passively over 120 s, using Event Horizon, Ion Storm and EMP.
- Space: hold for boost or stop, double-tap (or C / L3) for the perk.
- Perks unlock both in-match and persistently.
- Items go on R, and the capital skill goes on E.
- The gamepad table is exact.
Minus: Q can be cast in brownout, and there is no bomb-run ultimate.
notes.b: Five buttons, 3 ultimates plus 9 small path modifiers, 5 perks, and one R rule: prize if you carry one, else a bomb.
notes.c:
A clear class trio:
- Juggernaut: an anchored tank (Event Horizon + Polarize).
- Arcanist: a caster (Ion Storm + Gravity Well + Warp).
- Artificer: support (Overload with ally reboot + Repair on tap/hold).
Path identity comes only through the modifiers, and the Artificer's home perk, Overdrive, is its weakest identity piece.
notes.e: The spiral always captures, with handedness from id parity. Arena gets an x0.85 trim, the contest takes the strongest pull with 1.25x hysteresis, and Tractor, Vacuum and Magnet are all specced. But its own table contradicts its formula (1.00 s / 162 deg claimed vs 0.63 s / 87 deg measured at 228 px), and the measured curl is modest (29-81 deg).
notes.f: Safest numbers of the three: 18 flags (1 HIGH), the fewest lethal chains, the lowest dungeon ult share (15/29/23%), and every fix is a knob. The real Arena gap is 75-81 s (61 s claimed). FULL STOP is a trap on the Juggernaut.

notes.b: 9 specials, 9 ultimates, 7 perks, mastery ranks, field tiers and Open Loadout: the opposite of 'keep it simple and frantic'.
notes.c: 189 loadouts per class dilute what each class is, and the talents are rewritten to be variant-agnostic ('your special'). The signature options keep a baseline.
notes.e: The most visible spiral (56-132 deg, reproduced exactly) and an owner byte for pitched chimes. But passive pickup rises 2.65x (Juggernaut 2.92x), the owner byte costs 1 B per gem, and the Tractor perk is a persistent XP-pull option.
notes.f: 22 flags, no HIGH. The highest dungeon ult share (27/54/41%). The advertised Polarize + Event Horizon combo browns out at 4.3 s, and Ultimate Core breaks its 49 s floor.
notes.g: It renames InputState / ShipStats fields (44 files, ~411 identifier hits today). It also adds 25 new abilities, 2 projectile kinds, 2 deployables, and Profile v2 mastery with new server messages.

winner: Arcade Kit: Five Buttons, Three Ultimates

required_fixes.fix: Apply RAM_VS_SHIP_MULT 0.625 to Ram Charge hits vs ships, and to Slingshot.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim HIGH: Ram 400 + Salvo 3x180 = 940 raw takes down a full Arcanist (380 shield / 500 integrity). At 0.625 the burst is 790 raw and the Arcanist survives; Sortie's larger 312 Ram left it at 0/47.

required_fixes.fix:
- Juggernaut stopDecel 380 -> 620.
- FULL STOP runs at full strength and costs no power in brownout (drop the x0.5).
- A held brake counts toward load only while |v| > 5 px/s.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim S4: at 380, the Juggernaut's FULL STOP (0.77 s / 149 px) is slower than reversing thrust (0.67 s). The same holds for the Dreadnought n1 (0.90 vs 0.83 s). At 620: 0.53 s / 105 px, 4.9x faster than coasting; the Dreadnought n1 stops in 0.63 s.

required_fixes.fix: Lock Q in brownout; the Q ring shows BROWNOUT. EMP still locks it, and charge keeps accruing.
required_fixes.evidence: The owner's LMB+RMB+Space risk/reward rule, and the kitsim LOW flag (brown out on purpose, then ult). Hero and Sortie already lock it.

required_fixes.fix: Cap Polarize at 10 s per cast (the 4 s tap plus at most 6 s of sustain), then the 11 s cooldown from its end. Sustain stays at 200/s and 1 load.
required_fixes.evidence: Judge powergraft: sustain at 200-240/s never browns out off-fire in 60 s, so no price ends it. The cap bounds uptime at 10/21 = 48%, a fair ceiling for a tank that is 'fine to sit in a fight'.

The live stepWell pulls ships at the full 900. kitsim: a base well holds a Dreadnought n3 for 3 s, and Void + Deep Well holds a boosting Juggernaut for 5 s. A special out-pulls the Event Horizon ultimate.

required_fixes.fix: Floor E cooldowns at 6 s after every modifier (the owner's 6-14 s band). Flux Core no longer adds ult charge.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim: Void + Deep Well + Flux Core 4 keeps 1.2 wells alive (permanent). Flux Core 4 cuts the ult gap to 39 s, breaking the 52 s promise.

required_fixes.fix: Architect RMB Shield Wall: 2 charges recharging in 9 s each (was 7), at most 2 standing (was 3). Flux Core cannot push a charge below 7 s.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim: with 7 s charges and Flux Core 4, 1.3 walls stand on average: a permanent 2400 hp wall that reflects lasers.

required_fixes.fix: Pin the rift room-clear ult bonus as +6% to each live party pilot on the floor, not x6.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim MED: the x6 reading gives 38% more ults on floor 1.

required_fixes.fix: Event Horizon: a kamikaze swarmer that crosses the horizon ring is taken down at once through killEnemy, with no contact. Elites and bodies of radius 30+ keep the crush dps.
required_fixes.evidence: kitsim LOW: drones cross the 57 px band in 0.13 s, faster than the 900/s crush kills them, so they reach the hull. It also reads better: everything pops on the ring.

required_fixes.fix:
- Tender Repair Ray 170 -> 200 power/s; the Leech Siphon Ray costs the same.
- Self-repair, with no ally in the cone, only goes up to 75% of max integrity (the Hero rule).
required_fixes.evidence: Judge powergraft: Phaser + E-hold Ray at L2 goes from never browning out in 30 s to a first brownout at 13.8 s. This restores the CR judge's rule that builds which never brown out go away, while the Artificer stays the power-rich class.
The spec says both 'E acts on the rising edge' and 'hold >= 0.2 s = Ray'. As written, every Ray would first burn the 9 s Pulse.

required_fixes.fix: Replace the pip model with G1 and re-derive the spec's pip table from it.
required_fixes.evidence: The spec's table contradicts its own formula: 1.00 s / 162 deg claimed vs 0.63 s / 87 deg measured at 228 px.

required_fixes.fix: XP economy gate: time to level 3 (the path pick) in Warzone Classic and on rift floor 1 stays within +-20% of v0.5. Otherwise raise xpToNextFor or trim the well base.
required_fixes.evidence: Every kit roughly doubles passive pickup; G1 gives 1.95x.

required_fixes.fix: Re-validate the rift with ults on: riftParity with 4 and 6 bots, plus the 6-bot Veteran 3-floor run on at least 3 of 5 seeds. Budget +10-15% on the heat ramp.
required_fixes.evidence: The variant-C ramp was validated without ults. Arcade's ult share of each pulse is 15/29/23% on floors 1/3/6.

required_fixes.fix:
Align with the final presentation spec, §6 R7-R10:
- YouState.ultCharge u8 (255 = ready) replaces `ult` 0..1.
- A cast is `ability {skill: eventhorizon|ionstorm|overload}` plus `spool` for the tell.
- The flags2 bit is named BRAKE (Arcade's BRAKING); BOOST reuses SHIPFLAG_AFTERBURNER.
- A positional `powerup {shipId, kind, x, y}` event carries Tractor/Vacuum (instead of new `pickup` kinds).
- YouState.pullBoost {kind, sec} replaces `pull`.
- A shared pure pipWell(...) -> {radius, capture} lives in sim/gravity.ts.
- In the five-system panel, ults report 0 draw; boost and brake go to THRUSTERS; RMB, E, perks and R go to SPECIAL.
- The presentation's five-slot bar gains an R tile.
required_fixes.evidence: The final presentation spec R7, R8, R9 and R10 (v1-presentation-spec-final.md §6). R1-R6 (hullDamageTier in byte space, reactorCapMult / reactorRechargeMult, shieldBreak, hit layer/dir) come from CR unchanged.

grafts.why: The owner wants pips that 'visibly bend and orbit in'. Judge check: 53-118 deg of curl at 100-200 px with Arcade's own 1.95x economy (1.60x in Arena). Magnet L5 still doubles the width.
It passes the judge's burst rule.

grafts.what: SHIP_PULL_CAP 600 px/s^2 on the total hostile pull on one ship. Crowd-control diminishing returns: a stun, EMP offline window, slow or hostile pull within 3 s of the last one lasts 50%.
grafts.why: It stops Gravity Well, Event Horizon, Ion Storm and Overload from stacking into a lock.

grafts.what: A team-only ult-charge JSON tail `tu` (flat shipId, 0-100). It feeds the team strip, the rift roster and a ready ring on allied nameplates. Opponents never receive it, and the ship record is unchanged.
grafts.why: Overwatch-style ult coordination at no per-ship byte cost; cheaper than Hero's ShipView.ultFrac.

grafts.what: Flux Core never touches the ultimate (RF6).
RoomSettings.perkRule: 'unlocked' | 'all' | 'signature'. Defaults: 'all' in Arena and Arena house rooms; 'unlocked' in Warzone and Dungeon. 'signature' is the competitive option.
grafts.why: Pure PvP becomes identical for every account (the owner's sidegrade rule), while progression stays visible in PvE and PvPvE.
It meets 'persistent character data' with no migration and no non-cosmetic profile data. Every perk is reachable in a match, or within 5 matches. The fields exist in protocol.ts.

grafts.what: Pip victor priority: pips from a ship takedown ignore everyone but the victor and its crew for 1.5 s.
grafts.why: It keeps the PvP pip contest fair once wells overlap.

grafts.what: Widen flags2 to u16; the ship record grows 39 -> 40 B.
grafts.why: Arcade's 8 flags2 bits are all used. This leaves room for the presentation's recommended TRACTOR bit, SPOOL, and the v1.1 nebula's DISRUPTED, inside the one v1.0 protocol bump.
Every offensive ult gets a readable tell; Arcade's Ion Storm had none.
It keeps turret crews, a core SubSpace role, in the ult economy instead of disabling Q while docked.

grafts.what: Self-repair is capped at 75% of max integrity when no ally is in the Ray cone (RF10).
grafts.why: The Ray is a support tool, not a solo sustain loop.

rulings: Overdrive stays the Artificer's home perk, as a rotation and anti-crowd-control perk: cap x1.25, thrust x1.8, and while it runs, boost works inside gravity shear and ignores hostile pulls and slows. It is not tuned to beat Warp as an escape, because the 1-D chase always favours displacement (judge perkgraft: 55-61% vs 33%). Fairness comes from G6, G7 and the in-match Perk card. The objectiveParity soak decides: no perk may shift a class's DM takedown share by more than +-10%.

Keep one ultimate per class, reshaped by the path through modifiers. Hero's 9 path-bound ultimates are not grafted: that surface produced 24 flags, the inescapable EMP, the Wrecking Run loop and the Drone Carrier problem.

Ults cost no power and ignore the reactor tier; hullDamageTier and reactorCapMult stay as CR's shared functions. But ults are locked in brownout (RF3). A crippled reactor at tier 5 (-30% capacity) therefore browns out, and locks Q, more often. That is the intended danger: repair kits, the Repair Ray and Repair Bay restore the tier.
not_grafted: Hero's Carpet Bomb: offered to the owner as an option (below), not grafted.
gates: Ult economy: in a 5-minute, 16-bot Arena DM, each bot casts 0.5-1.0 ults per minute (kitsim for Arcade: 0.74), and DM stays at 15 or more takedowns per minute with ults on. On a 6-bot rift floor 1: 0.5-1.0 per bot per minute.
objectiveParity with random perks: no perk shifts a class's DM takedown share by more than +-10%.
riftParity with 4 and 6 bots, and the 6-bot Veteran 3-floor run, with ults on (RF14).
Predictor == server over 120 ticks of scripted Space boost / brake / double-tap perk / E tap vs hold / Q, for capitals n = 0..5.
Stop table within +-2 ticks, including the RF2 values: FULL STOP must beat counter-thrust on every hull, n = 0..5.
Pip unit tests match the G1 table within +-3 ticks and +-10 deg. The contest owner is identical on both hosts and never flips within 0.5 s at the hysteresis boundary. Victor priority holds.
Burst rule: nothing short of an ult combo takes down a full Arcanist (checked: Ram + Salvo, and 2 bombs).
open_questions_for_owner: You listed a bomb run / carpet bombs as a possible ultimate. In the winner, bombs stay on R as standard issue, and the Juggernaut's ult is Event Horizon. Do you want Hero's Carpet Bomb as the Barrage path's ultimate instead? The cost is the 'one ultimate per class' simplicity.
The Architect trades Deploy Sentry for a 2-charge Shield Wall on RMB, and Summoner and Medic Artificers have no wall. OK?
Per your rule the capital skill replaces E. So a hosting Dreadnought loses Polarize, a Spire loses Gravity Well, and a Foundry loses Repair (it keeps tap = Bay, hold = Ray). Confirm?
May docked turret pilots fire their ultimate (G11), or should Q be disabled while docked?
